documents_not_found: This document doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.
documents_tree_keyboard_hint: Keyboard: Alt+Up/Down to reorder, Alt+Right/Left to indent or outdent, Alt+Enter for a subdocument.
documents_restore_conflict: Revision {revision} was saved in the meantime. Finish saving or reload, then restore again.
documents_history_description: This is revision {revision}. Restoring creates a new revision with the chosen revision's content, and earlier history stays. Linked task and progress states aren't rolled back.
documents_history_pick: Choose a revision on the left.
documents_compare_current_hint: Current (r{current}) → r{selected}: what restoring would change
documents_compare_previous_hint: r{previous} → r{selected}: what changed in this revision
documents_title_conflict: It was saved elsewhere at the same time. Try again.
documents_live_denied: You no longer have access to this document, so the connection was closed.
documents_live_invalid: The server rejected a change, so the connection was closed. Please reload.
documents_live_hint: Several people edit this document together. Changes are shared right away and kept as a revision after a quiet moment or when everyone leaves.
documents_save_retrying: Can't reach the server, trying again. Your edits are kept in this browser.
documents_signed_out: Your sign-in expired. Your edits are kept in this browser. Please sign in again.
documents_leave_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway? (The draft is kept in this browser.)
documents_draft_found: There's an unsaved draft in this browser ({time}).
documents_conflict_body: The server has revision {revision}. Your draft is still here. Compare them, then choose.
documents_conflict_keep_copy: Keep my draft as a note
documents_overwrite_description: Your draft is saved as a new revision on top of server revision {revision}. The server version stays in the revision history.
documents_move_changed: Who can access it changed in the meantime. Check again.
documents_personal_owner: Personal note · Only people you share with
documents_share_description: People you share with read or edit this original. They must sign in with an account verified for that email.
documents_share_description_personal: A shared personal note stays yours and isn't visible to the recipient's workspace admins.
documents_restrict_only: This document is under an archived item. You can only make changes that reduce exposure, such as revoking shares or public links or making it private.
documents_private_label: Private (author, admins, and people it's shared with)
documents_use_as_template: Use as a template (viewers can start new documents from this body)
documents_copy_limit: Blocking duplication can't stop people from photographing what's on screen.
documents_public_link_hint: Anyone with the link can read it without signing in. You can revoke it at any time.
documents_copy_description: Creates a separate new document. It won't stay in sync with the original.
documents_move_description: Move it to a wiki or a module item. It gets a new number from the destination (WIKI for a wiki, the module key for an item). Existing links use the document ID and keep working.
documents_move_history: Earlier revision history moves too and becomes visible to the people gaining access.
documents_move_reference_changes: It gets a new number at the destination.
documents_move_reference_same: It stays in the same module, so the number doesn't change.

match.countPlural=one: {count} subdocument stays where it is and moves under this document's parent.
match.countPlural=other: {count} subdocuments stay where they are and move under this document's parent.

match.countPlural=one: {count} active public link stays, so it can still be read without signing in. To stop that, revoke it in Share & settings.
match.countPlural=other: {count} active public links stay, so they can still be read without signing in. To stop that, revoke them in Share & settings.

documents_file_inserted: Inserted {name} (it's also in the document's attachments).
documents_math_clear_hint: Replacing with an empty value deletes the math.
documents_markdown_lossy: This document has formatting Markdown can't represent exactly. If you go back without editing the source, the original stays; if you edit it, the document is rebuilt from the source when saved.
documents_export_markdown_hint: Images and attachments link to their fvoci addresses.
documents_export_zip_hint: Includes the images and attachments you can download, linked by relative paths.
documents_export_pdf_hint: Choose “Save as PDF” in the print dialog. It uses this device's fonts.
documents_export_lossy: Blocks that couldn't be converted to Markdown exactly: {blocks} (also noted in a comment at the top of the file)
documents_export_forbidden: This document can't be exported (the owner doesn't allow duplicating or downloading).
documents_export_description: Export one saved revision as a file.
documents_export_unsaved: You have unsaved edits. Save first to include them. Exporting now uses saved revision {revision}.
documents_export_live: For a live document, only content already kept as a revision is exported (a revision is kept after a quiet moment or when everyone leaves).
